```go
package cli

import (
	"strconv"
	"testing"
)

func TestCfgOptions(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name      string
		args      []string
		wantMax   int
		wantErr   bool
		isError   bool
	}{
		{
			name:    "Happy path with max length",
			args:    []string{"--max", "10"},
			wantMax: 10,
			wantErr: false,
		},
		{
			name:    "No arguments",
			args:    []string{},
			wantMax: 0,
			wantErr: false,
		},
		{
			name:    "Invalid max value",
			args:    []string{"--max", "abc"},
			wantMax: 0,
			wantErr: true,
		},
		{
			name:    "Missing value for max",
			args:    []string{"--max"},
			wantMax: 0,
			wantErr: true,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			gotMax, err := cfgOptions(tt.args)

			if (err != nil) != tt.wantErr {
				t.Errorf("cfgOptions() error = %v, wantErr %v", err, tt.wantErr)
				return
			}
			if gotMax != tt.wantMax {
				t.Errorf("cfgOptions() gotMax = %v, wantMax %v", gotMax, tt.wantMax)
			}
		})
	}
}

func BenchmarkCfgOptions(b *testing.B) {
	args := []string{"--max", "10"}
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		_, _ = cfgOptions(args)
	}
}
```
